name: input_output_scale
hypothesis: Scale height, horizontal position, and horizontal velocity inputs to increase sensitivity to altitude and wind, and bias the action logits toward the main engine and side thrusters to counter stronger gravity and wind.

name: adjust_inputs_outputs
hypothesis: Scale height and horizontal velocity to increase sensitivity to altitude and wind, offset height lower and vertical velocity more negative to trigger the main engine earlier, offset x and horizontal velocity positive to make the policy think it is drifting right and thus fire the right side thruster more, and boost the main engine and side‑thruster logits to compensate for weaker main thrust and stronger wind.

name: wind_gravity_adjust
hypothesis: Scale horizontal position and velocity inputs to increase response to wind, offset height and vertical velocity downwards to trigger earlier main engine, boost main engine and side thruster logits to compensate for weaker thrust and stronger gravity, and discourage turning off early.

name: wind_gravity_adjust2
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to height, vertical velocity, horizontal position and velocity to counter stronger gravity and wind; offset height lower and vertical velocity more negative to fire the main engine earlier; offset x and horizontal velocity positive to bias the left side thruster; boost main engine and left side thruster logits and discourage turning off.

name: gravity_wind_bias
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to height, horizontal and vertical velocity to fire the main engine earlier under stronger gravity; offset height lower and vertical velocity more negative to trigger earlier thrust; boost side‑thruster and main‑engine logits to compensate for weaker main thrust and strong wind; slightly amplify hidden activations for overall stronger response.

name: gravity_wind_input_output_hidden
hypothesis: Amplify height, vertical velocity, horizontal position and horizontal velocity inputs to react earlier to stronger gravity and wind; offset height lower and vertical velocity more negative to trigger earlier main thrust; boost main engine and side‑thruster logits; amplify hidden layer 2 to increase overall output magnitude.

name: balanced_input_hidden_output
hypothesis: Increase sensitivity to horizontal offset and velocity (wind) while modestly scaling height and vertical velocity to fire earlier under stronger gravity; offset height downwards and vertical velocity more negative to trigger earlier main thrust; amplify hidden layer 2 slightly; boost main engine and both side‑thruster logits and discourage the off action.

name: enhanced_input_hidden_output
hypothesis: Amplify the influence of horizontal offset, horizontal velocity, height and vertical velocity to counter strong wind and increased gravity; offset height lower and vertical velocity more negative so the policy perceives a lower altitude and faster fall, prompting earlier main‑engine use; boost the logits for the side‑thrusters and main engine while penalising the off action; slightly amplify hidden layer 2 to increase overall response strength.

name: bias_and_input_scale
hypothesis: Increase left side engine and main engine bias to counter weaker thrust and stronger gravity, and amplify sensitivity to horizontal offset and velocity to counter wind. Also offset height and vertical velocity downwards so the policy perceives a lower altitude and faster fall, triggering earlier main thrust.

name: wind_compensate_v2
hypothesis: Amplify the influence of horizontal offset and velocity (to counter strong wind) and moderately increase height and vertical‑velocity sensitivity (to fire the weaker main engine earlier). Apply a small negative offset to height and vertical velocity so the policy perceives a lower altitude and faster fall, encouraging earlier thrust. Slightly boost the hidden layer 2 activations for overall stronger responses and add positive bias to the main‑engine and side‑thruster logits while penalising the off action.

name: wind_gravity_input_output_hidden_v2
hypothesis: Scale horizontal offset and velocity strongly to counter wind, modestly increase height and vertical velocity sensitivity to fire the weaker main engine earlier, offset height downwards and vertical velocity more negative to make the policy think it is lower and falling faster, boost main engine and side‑thruster logits while penalising the off action, and slightly amplify hidden layer 2 for overall stronger response.

name: full_bias_input_hidden
hypothesis: Scale all position, height, and velocity inputs to increase sensitivity to wind and stronger gravity, offset height downwards and vertical velocity more negative so the policy perceives a lower altitude and faster fall, amplify hidden layers to boost overall network response, and bias the action logits toward the main engine and side thrusters while penalising the off action.
